tweets.text: Waking up drenched in sweat at 2am isn't just "part of menopause" you have to accept. Your pillow might be working against you. 🧵

3 cooling options we compared for menopause night sweats:
1) Coop Home Goods Cooling Pillow -- adjustable loft, good if you run hot and want to customize firmness
2) Elviros Cervical Cooling Pillow -- built-in neck support, good if stiffness comes with the heat
3) Linenspa Cooling Gel Topper -- for when it's the whole bed, not just the pillow, that feels too hot

Before: tossing the pillow off the bed at 3am, flipping to the "cool side" every 20 minutes.
After: picking cooling gear that actually matches your type of night sweat -- head-only, neck + shoulders, or whole-bed heat -- instead of guessing.

Full guide breaks down all 3 picks plus a quick self-check to find your night-sweat type. Not medical advice, just a practical way to compare the options: https://lionlion0201-jpg.github.io/home-recovery-blog/posts/best-cooling-pillow-for-menopause-night-sweats/
